sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即便是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，然后把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成一个活生生的、充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the biggest ISIS stronghold in Iraq seems on the verge of falling to U.S.-backed forces.
sentences.zh: 今天，伊拉克境内最大的ISIS据点似乎即将被美国支持的部队攻克。

sentences.en: We go into the streets to see if a major victory over radical Islam is really at hand.
sentences.zh: 我们深入街头，看看针对激进伊斯兰势力的重大胜利是否真的近在咫尺。

sentences.en: And back in the United States, he tweets they overreact, why the smartest minds in finance cannot predict the Trump effect on stock prices.
sentences.zh: 回到美国，他发推特说他们反应过度，为什么金融界最聪明的大脑也无法预测特朗普对股价的影响。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月23日，星期四。

sentences.en: In the war against ISIS, its last great base in Iraq, its on-the-ground claim to a religious empire, lies in one half of one city.
sentences.zh: 在打击ISIS的战争中，其在伊拉克的最后一个大本营，即其在地面上宣称的宗教帝国，正位于一座城市的一半区域内。

sentences.en: For those who want to see ISIS destroyed, its final chapter in Iraq is perhaps being written now, and it's being written in Mosul.
sentences.zh: 对于那些希望看到ISIS被摧毁的人来说，它在伊拉克的终章或许正在书写，而书写地点就在摩苏尔。

sentences.en: So Mosul right now is a divided city.
sentences.zh: 所以，摩苏尔现在是一座分裂的城市。

sentences.en: Rukmini Kalamaki, who has covered ISIS for years, has been in and out of Mosul for the past few months.
sentences.zh: 多年来一直报道ISIS的鲁克米尼·卡拉马基，在过去几个月里多次进出摩苏尔。

sentences.en: The eastern half was declared liberated at the end of January.
sentences.zh: 东半部在1月底被宣布解放。

sentences.en: And most of those neighborhoods, to be perfectly frank, look pretty normal to me.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，那些街区大部分看起来都很正常。

sentences.en: You drive around.
sentences.zh: 你开车四处转转。

sentences.en: You see vegetable sellers, open markets, customers.
sentences.zh: 你会看到卖菜的、露天市场和顾客。

sentences.en: I'm now trying on the burqa.
sentences.zh: 我现在正在试戴罩袍。

sentences.en: What is this?
sentences.zh: 这是什么？

sentences.en: Like this?
sentences.zh: 像这样吗？

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Restaurants are open.
sentences.zh: 餐馆都开门了。

sentences.en: I was able to have lunch in a beautiful Mosul restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我还在摩苏尔一家很棒的餐馆吃了午饭。

sentences.en: But the liberated part of the city ends at the Tigris River, which essentially cuts the city in two.
sentences.zh: 但城市已解放的部分止步于底格里斯河，这条河实际上把城市一分为二。

sentences.en: The western part of Mosul is still completely under ISIS occupation.
sentences.zh: 摩苏尔西部仍完全处于ISIS的占领之下。

sentences.en: And that's the part where Iraqi forces are now inching towards.
sentences.zh: 那正是伊拉克军队现在正缓慢推进的地方。

sentences.en: And it's a no-go zone.
sentences.zh: 那是个禁区。

sentences.en: We've been told to not move around there unless you're in an armored vehicle.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知，除非乘坐装甲车，否则不要在那里走动。

sentences.en: And even from the armored vehicle, you can hear the bollies going overhead, the occasional mortar rounds,
sentences.zh: 即使在装甲车里，你也能听到头顶呼啸的子弹声、偶尔响起的迫击炮声，

sentences.en: and, you know, the rat-tat-tat of machine gun fire.
sentences.zh: 还有，你知道的，机关枪的哒哒声。

sentences.en: It's into this western half that Iraqi forces are now preparing to mount the second stage of their assault on the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克军队正准备向这西半部发起对伊斯兰国的第二阶段进攻。

sentences.en: If they regain control, they'll reunite Mosul and liberate a city that has been under ISIS rule for nearly three years.
sentences.zh: 如果他们夺回控制权，他们将重新统一摩苏尔，解放这座被ISIS统治了近三年的城市。

sentences.en: Planes flew overhead this week, carpeting the ground with leaflets.
sentences.zh: 本周飞机从头顶飞过，在地面上铺天盖地地撒下传单。

sentences.en: This is your last opportunity to quit your work with ISIS, they said.
sentences.zh: 传单上写着：这是你们停止为ISIS效力的最后机会。

sentences.en: Stay at home, raising the white flag as the forces approach.
sentences.zh: 待在家里，在部队靠近时挂起白旗。

sentences.en: I talked to Rukmini last night from her hotel in Iraq about what she's seeing and what this fight means.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我从伊拉克的酒店与鲁克米尼通了话，谈论了她的所见所闻以及这场战斗的意义。

sentences.en: Mosul is the most important city for ISIS in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 摩苏尔是ISIS在伊拉克最重要的城市。

sentences.en: This is really where they planted their flag.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他们插旗的地方。

sentences.en: In June of 2014, when Mosul fell, that was really the moment, I think, when the world woke up and went, oh my God, you know, what is this group?
sentences.zh: 2014年6月摩苏尔陷落时，我认为那真的是全世界惊醒并意识到‘天哪，这个组织到底是什么？’的时刻。

sentences.en: And it was in Mosul that Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, the leader of the Islamic State, declared the caliphate in June of 2014.
sentences.zh: 正是2014年6月，伊斯兰国领导人阿布·贝克尔·巴格达迪在摩苏尔宣布建立哈里发国。

sentences.en: So for that reason alone, it has enormous significance.
sentences.zh: 所以仅凭这一点，它就具有巨大的意义。

sentences.en: And when we say the caliphate, can you remind us of exactly what it is?
sentences.zh: 当我们提到哈里发国时，你能提醒我们它到底是什么吗？

sentences.en: The caliphate in the eyes of the Islamic State is basically the territory where their version, their very narrow version of Islam is practiced.
sentences.zh: 在伊斯兰国眼中，哈里发国基本上就是他们那种极其狭隘的伊斯兰教义被实践的领土。

sentences.en: In their mind, this is what the entire world should be.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，全世界都应该是这个样子。

sentences.en: I've seen Islamic State maps where they basically have the black flag planted in every country on the planet.
sentences.zh: 我见过伊斯兰国的地图，他们基本上在地球上的每个国家都插上了黑旗。

sentences.en: But to them, this is the beachhead.
sentences.zh: 但对他们来说，这是滩头阵地。

sentences.en: From here, they're going to colonize the world.
sentences.zh: 从这里开始，他们要殖民全世界。

sentences.en: And if it were to be lost, what would that say about ISIS and its future and the future of the caliphate?
sentences.zh: 如果这里失守，这对ISIS及其未来，以及哈里发国的未来意味着什么？

sentences.en: Number one, it'll be a symbolic blow to the caliphate.
sentences.zh: 第一，这将是对哈里发国的象征性打击。

sentences.en: Number two, there'll be, I think, a significant economic downturn for ISIS.
sentences.zh: 第二，我认为ISIS的经济将出现重大衰退。

sentences.en: ISIS makes most of its money from taxes.
sentences.zh: ISIS大部分收入来自税收。

sentences.en: I know there's a perception out there that they make most of their money from oil.
sentences.zh: 我知道外界有一种看法，认为他们大部分钱来自石油。

sentences.en: There is.
sentences.zh: 确实有。

sentences.en: That's not the case, right?
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Oil is a part of their income stream, but it's not the biggest slice of the pie.
sentences.zh: 石油是他们收入来源的一部分，但不是最大的一块蛋糕。

sentences.en: The biggest slice of the pie is taxes.
sentences.zh: 最大的一块蛋糕是税收。

sentences.en: And so taxes come from controlling people and land.
sentences.zh: 所以税收来自于对人口和土地的控制。

sentences.en: Every single household in Mosul had to pay a monthly tax to ISIS.
sentences.zh: 摩苏尔的每一户人家都必须向ISIS缴纳月税。

sentences.en: ISIS would go house to house to collect this, and you had to pay up, right?
sentences.zh: ISIS会挨家挨户去收，你必须如数上交，对吧？

sentences.en: So as far as its economics,
sentences.zh: 所以就经济而言，

sentences.en: Mosul is also important in that way.
sentences.zh: 摩苏尔在这方面也很重要。

sentences.en: You have this really unusually up-close view of what life is like under ISIS, and very few people have it.
sentences.zh: 你对ISIS统治下的生活有着非常近距离的观察，很少有人能做到这一点。

sentences.en: What is day-to-day existence like in Mosul under ISIS control?
sentences.zh: 在ISIS控制下的摩苏尔，日常生活是什么样的？

sentences.en: So first of all, that answer is different depending on your gender.
sentences.zh: 首先，这个答案取决于你的性别。

sentences.en: If you're a woman, your life is mostly indoors.
sentences.zh: 如果你是女性，你的生活大部分是在室内度过的。

sentences.en: The Islamic State made it almost impossible for women to have any life outside of the home.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰国让女性几乎不可能在户外有任何生活。

sentences.en: They were hounded by the religious police for the most minor of infractions, including not covering their hands or showing their eyes.
sentences.zh: 她们因最微小的违规行为而受到宗教警察的骚扰，包括没遮住手或露出了眼睛。

sentences.en: For men, on the other hand, if you're an adherent of the Islamic State and are not suspected of dissent of any kind, then you went about your daily life in a somewhat normal way.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，对于男性来说，如果你是伊斯兰国的追随者，且没有被怀疑有任何异议，那么你的日常生活在某种程度上是正常的。

sentences.en: So doctors were able to practice medicine, merchants continued to sell their wares, bureaucrats, you know, went to the office.
sentences.zh: 医生可以行医，商人继续卖货，公务员去办公室上班。

sentences.en: The difference was that there was a veneer of Sharia law that was placed over everything.
sentences.zh: 不同之处在于，一切事物上都覆盖着一层伊斯兰教法的外衣。

sentences.en: So, for example, smoking was forbidden.
sentences.zh: 例如，禁止吸烟。

sentences.en: Drinking, of course, was taboo.
sentences.zh: 饮酒当然是禁忌。

sentences.en: You had to wear your trousers at a particular length in keeping with their reading of how the Prophet Muhammad used to dress.
sentences.zh: 你必须按照他们对先知穆罕默德着装方式的解读，把裤子穿到特定的长度。

sentences.en: You had to obey all of the five prayers.
sentences.zh: 你必须遵守全部五次礼拜。

sentences.en: And if you didn't close your shop on Fridays during the major Friday prayer, you would be reprimanded or worse.
sentences.zh: 如果你在周五的主要礼拜期间没有关店，你就会受到训斥，甚至更糟。

sentences.en: And what happened if you did oppose these strictures?
sentences.zh: 如果反抗这些限制会发生什么？

sentences.en: There's just no flexibility at all.
sentences.zh: 根本没有任何灵活性可言。

sentences.en: I mean, people that raised their heads in any way were immediately imprisoned.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，任何敢于抬头的人都会立即被监禁。

sentences.en: And executions were public.
sentences.zh: 而且处决是公开的。

sentences.en: They were happening in regular intervals.
sentences.zh: 它们定期发生。

sentences.en: People talked about how they'd be, you know, they'd be going to the market just to buy a kilogram of meat.
sentences.zh: 人们谈论他们如何，你知道的，他们只是去市场买一公斤肉。

sentences.en: And they would come across a scene where they were stoning to death a couple for allegations of adultery.
sentences.zh: 然后就会撞见他们因为通奸指控而用石头砸死一对夫妇的场景。

sentences.en: Or they would walk past the place where they were about to behead somebody who was accused of sorcery or whatever crime they, you know, they allocated to them.
sentences.zh: 或者他们会路过即将斩首某人的地方，那人被指控犯有巫术或任何他们分配给他们的罪行。

sentences.en: You're describing the culture of life under ISIS.
sentences.zh: 你正在描述ISIS统治下的生活文化。

sentences.en: And I'm trying to understand if a sizable portion of the population there sided with ISIS over the Iraqi government.
sentences.zh: 我想了解那里是否有相当一部分人口站在ISIS一边，而不是伊拉克政府一边。

sentences.en: If they were finding themselves sympathetic to this in one way or another when it comes to kind of the hearts and minds factor at play with all of this.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到所有这些因素中的民心向背时，他们是否在某种程度上对这个组织抱有同情？

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: I think the numbers speak volumes.
sentences.zh: 我认为数字说明了一切。

sentences.en: I was told that before ISIS's invasion, the population of Mosul was around 2 million.
sentences.zh: 我被告知，在ISIS入侵之前，摩苏尔的人口约为200万。

sentences.en: After ISIS and at the beginning of the intervention by the Iraqi army to try to take it back last fall, the city still had a population that was estimated at 1 million.
sentences.zh: 在ISIS统治之后，以及去年秋天伊拉克军队开始干预试图夺回该市时，城市人口估计仍有100万。

sentences.en: So basically half the population managed to flee, but half stayed.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上有一半人口设法逃离了，但有一半留了下来。

sentences.en: And of that half that stayed, there are certainly people that were, like my translator, my translator explained that the reason he didn't leave
sentences.zh: 而在留下来的那一半人中，肯定有人像我的翻译一样，我的翻译解释说他没有离开的原因

sentences.en: is that he and his father own a beautiful home.
sentences.zh: 是他和他的父亲拥有一栋漂亮的房子。

sentences.en: And had they left, the home would have been seized by ISIS and it would have been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 如果他们离开，房子就会被ISIS没收并被摧毁。

sentences.en: And that's the family's main wealth.
sentences.zh: 那是这个家庭的主要财富。

sentences.en: So they chose to stay and they managed to get to the end of this difficult, nearly three-year stint.
sentences.zh: 所以他们选择留下来，并设法熬过了这艰难的近三年。

sentences.en: But beyond people like my translator, you have to imagine that there were quite a good number of people that did collaborate with them.
sentences.zh: 但除了像我翻译这样的人之外，你必须想象肯定有相当多的人与他们合作了。

sentences.en: You know, they were on the Islamic State's payroll, either as traffic cops or as members of the religious police or as petty bureaucrats.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们领着伊斯兰国的工资，要么是交通警察，要么是宗教警察成员，或者是小官僚。

sentences.en: And at some level, they must have been okay with that.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，他们一定对此没意见。

sentences.en: Because they stayed.
sentences.zh: 因为他们留下来了。

sentences.en: Because they stayed.
sentences.zh: 因为他们留下来了。

sentences.en: And that's the thing that we are all, you know, wrestling with.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们都在纠结的事情。

sentences.en: It's easy to see how there could have been a reaction to the perceived corruption, you know, of the Iraqi state.
sentences.zh: 很容易看出人们为何会对伊拉克政府被认为存在的腐败产生反弹。

sentences.en: So initially, I think ISIS brought this order and they brought a promise of ending corruption.
sentences.zh: 所以起初，我认为ISIS带来了秩序，并带来了结束腐败的承诺。

sentences.en: You could see how in the beginning this would have been appealing.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出为什么在开始时这很有吸引力。

sentences.en: But as the brutality multiplied and as the extremeness of the group increased, it's surprising to me how many people did collaborate with them.
sentences.zh: 但随着暴行的加剧和组织极端程度的提高，有多少人与他们合作，这让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And that's something that I'm trying very hard to understand, you know, on this trip.
sentences.zh: 这是我在此次行程中非常努力想要理解的事情。

sentences.en: I want to talk about when these Iraqi soldiers are going through the streets, how exactly do they fight ISIS?
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈当这些伊拉克士兵穿过街道时，他们究竟是如何与ISIS作战的？

sentences.en: How do they even know that they're looking at ISIS?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么知道自己面对的是ISIS？

sentences.en: It's urban warfare.
sentences.zh: 这是城市战。

sentences.en: I mean, what ISIS has been doing is aggressively using suicide bombers, car bombs, to create spectacular explosions and basically spook the advancing army.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，ISIS一直在积极使用自杀式炸弹袭击者和汽车炸弹，制造壮观的爆炸，基本上是为了吓唬推进的军队。

sentences.en: The other thing that they're doing is all over East and West Mosul.
sentences.zh: 他们做的另一件事遍布摩苏尔东部和西部。

sentences.en: In East Mosul, in just one little district called Tilkif, on just one morning where I was there, I was shown
sentences.zh: 在摩苏尔东部，就在一个叫泰尔凯夫的小区，我待在那里的一个早上，我被展示了

sentences.en: four or five enormous tunnels that had been built in people's living rooMs.
sentences.zh: 四五个建在人们客厅里的巨大隧道。

sentences.en: So you go into the house and there's basically a hole the size of the living room, dirt in every other room of the house.
sentences.zh: 你走进房子，基本上有一个客厅那么大的洞，房子的其他房间里全是泥土。

sentences.en: In some instances, the dirt was all the way up to the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，泥土一直堆到了天花板。

sentences.en: And then you peer down into this black hole that we were told, you know, extends for hundreds of yards in certain instances.
sentences.zh: 然后你往这个黑洞里看，据说在某些情况下，它延伸了数百码。

sentences.en: So they use them to hide and they use them to be able to move from building to building without the coalition being able to see them from the air.
sentences.zh: 所以他们用这些隧道来躲藏，并利用它们在建筑物之间移动，而联军无法从空中看到他们。

sentences.en: And they're literally crawling underneath the forces trying to stamp them out.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上是在试图消灭他们的部队脚下爬行。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And the other technique that they're using to great effect in recent months is they've been using drones that as far as we can tell are just commercially available drones
sentences.zh: 近几个月来，他们使用的另一种非常有效的技术是无人机，据我们所知，这些只是商用无人机，

sentences.en: that you can buy in malls, you know, across the region.
sentences.zh: 你在该地区的商场里就能买到。

sentences.en: They've been able to engineer them to carry explosives.
sentences.zh: 他们已经能够对其进行改造以携带爆炸物。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Usually it's quite small.
sentences.zh: 通常很小。

sentences.en: It'll be like a grenade or two.
sentences.zh: 就像一两枚手榴弹。

sentences.en: But everywhere where I've been with the Iraqi army, they're constantly talking about this.
sentences.zh: 但无论我随伊拉克军队去哪里，他们都在不断谈论这件事。

sentences.en: So this is an army that was used to being able to move against the Islamic State and having the air advantage on their side, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一支习惯于在拥有空中优势的情况下对抗伊斯兰国的军队，你知道的。

sentences.en: Right, the drones.
sentences.zh: 对，无人机。

sentences.en: That had the drones, right.
sentences.zh: 就是那些无人机，没错。

sentences.en: Literally the drones.
sentences.zh: 确实就是无人机。
